svg.title: Where I live and places I’ve visited around the world
svg.desc: United States is solid green: currently living in San Jose, California. Visited: United Kingdom, Japan, South Korea, United Arab Emirates, Kenya, Canada, China, Taiwan, and Mexico. Ochre highlights and dots identify visited places, not cities. Detailed U.S. travels are shown on the separate United States map.
